title: Stocks - Apple, Boeing, Facebook Rise in Premarket; Tesla Drops By Investing.com
text:
This article has already been saved in your Saved Items © Reuters.
Investing.com - Stocks in focus in premarket trade Wednesday:
• Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) stock gained 1.01% by 8:13 AM ET (13:13 GMT) despite a report that the company is cutting its production plan for new iPhones by about 10% for the January-March quarter, according to the Nikkei Asian Review.
• Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA ) stock fell 0.51% amid news that the family of a Florida man who died in a high-speed automobile accident sued the company on allegations that the Tesla battery was defective and the company was negligent upon removing a speed limiter on the car.
• Boeing (NYSE: BA ) stock rose 0.73% as it unveiled a faster, higher-flying plane aimed at reducing fuel consumption.
• Facebook (NASDAQ: FB ) stock edged forward 0.54% amid news that CEO Mark Zuckerberg will hold public discussions about the future of technology for society as part of his New Year’s resolutions.
• Chesapeake Energy (NYSE: CHK ) stock soared 5.71% after the company’s forecast for quarter production beat consensus.
• Constellation Brands (NYSE: STZ ) stock tumbled 12.15% after the company reported full-year earnings guidance that missed analysts’ expectations.
• Gogo (NASDAQ: GOGO ) stock jumped 10.68% after the company reported positive results from efforts to protect against de-icing fluid contamination and lifted its adjusted profit forecast to the high end of the previously given range. Stocks - Apple, Boeing, Facebook Rise in Premarket; Tesla Drops
